DestEditor.AddOnlyDesc: Copy new and changed files; never delete from the destination.
DestEditor.CatchAllHint: This rule takes everything the rules above it left, so it has no file selection of its own.
DestEditor.CollisionLabel: If that name is already taken
DestEditor.DestinationOverlapHintFormat: This folder overlaps a destination of task "{0}" — tasks never share destinations.
DestEditor.ExcludeTip: Exclude — sync everything except files matching this rule
DestEditor.Flatten: Put every file directly in the folder
DestEditor.KeepStructure: Keep the folders they are in
DestEditor.MirrorDesc: Make the destination identical to the source, empty folders included. Extras are deleted.
DestEditor.NamePlaceholder: Optional — defaults to the folder's name
DestEditor.NeedsFilterRule: no files selected — add a rule, or choose "All files"
DestEditor.NeedsSeparateFolder: Destination must be a separate folder outside the source (and not contain it).
DestEditor.SiblingOverlapHintFormat: This folder overlaps "{0}" in this task — destinations never overlap each other.
DestEditor.VerifyContents: Verify file contents (xxHash) after each copy
DestEditor.VerifyNetworkWarning: This is a network location. Content verification re-reads every copied file over the network (slower, more bandwidth). It guards against silent/hardware corruption the network protocol does not.
DestEditor.WildcardHint: * matches within one folder level, ? one character, ** any number of levels — so **/ChatGPT*.png finds those files anywhere under the source.
Enum.FileNameCollisionPolicy.Skip: Leave the file and report it
Enum.FileNameCollisionPolicy.Suffix: Add a number to the name
Filter.NoRulesPreview: No rules yet — nothing will be synced.
Filter.OpaqueRules: rules this editor can't show (kept as they are)
LogViewer.Empty: Nothing in the log about this destination yet.
LogViewer.OpenLogFileTip: Open the whole log in your default text editor
LogViewer.Title: Sync log
Main.ConfigUnreadableDetail: The configuration file exists but could not be read, so no tasks are shown. They have not been deleted. Changes will not be saved until SyncMaid restarts and reads the file successfully.
Main.ConfigUnreadableTitle: Your tasks could not be loaded
Main.DeleteTaskMessageFormat: Delete the task "{0}" and {1}? This can't be undone. Your files at both ends are left alone.
Main.EmptyState: No tasks yet — add the first one with New task.
MirrorDelete.ExplanationPermanentFormat: Syncing “{0}” will permanently delete {1} files that are no longer in the source.
MirrorDelete.ExplanationRecycleFormat: Syncing “{0}” will move {1} files to the Recycle Bin — they are no longer in the source.
Settings.CloseToTray: Close to the system tray instead of exiting
Settings.CloseToTrayDesc: Keeps SyncMaid running in the tray when you close the window, so scheduled and watched tasks keep syncing.
Settings.StartMinimized: Start minimized to the system tray
Settings.StartMinimizedDesc: SyncMaid launches hidden with only the tray icon; tasks run as usual. Click the tray icon to open the window. Takes effect on the next launch.
Settings.StartupDisabledByWindows: Startup is turned off for SyncMaid in Windows Task Manager (Startup apps). Turn it back on there to allow starting with Windows.
Settings.StartWithWindowsDesc: Opens the main window at sign-in.
Settings.StoragePortableDesc: SyncMaid is portable: everything it saves lives beside the executable, so moving the folder takes your tasks with it and the machine keeps nothing.
Settings.Title: Settings
Task.DeleteDestinationMessageFormat: Remove the destination "{0}" from this task? This can't be undone. The files already there are left alone.
Task.OverlapRefusedFormat: This task's paths overlap task "{0}"; fix the overlap and run again — no files were changed.
Task.ReviewDeletionsTip: Review what this run would delete
Task.TriggerErrorRecoverableFormat: Automatic trigger error; automatic runs may be temporarily unavailable. You can still run the task manually. ({0})
Task.TriggerErrorStartFormat: This task's trigger failed to start, so it only runs when you run it manually. ({0})
TaskEditor.CronFields: Five fields: minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week.
TaskEditor.CronInvalid: Enter a valid cron expression (e.g. */5 * * * *); times use local time
TaskEditor.CronNoUpcoming: Valid in local time, but has no upcoming runs
TaskEditor.KindLockedHint: The kind is fixed while the task has destinations — remove them first to change it.
TaskEditor.KindMoveDesc: File the source away: each file goes to the first rule that matches it and leaves the source.
TaskEditor.KindSyncDesc: Copy the source to its destinations and leave it where it is. Each destination picks its own files.
TaskEditor.MissingFolderHint: This folder doesn't exist. Check for typos — the task won't find anything to sync (and a watch trigger can't start) until it does.
TaskEditor.SettleHint: Every new change restarts the wait, so one burst of writes becomes one sync run. Set it longer than the slowest save your source sees.
TaskEditor.SourceOverlapHintFormat: This folder overlaps the source of task "{0}" — tasks never share sources.
TaskEditor.Title: Task
Workspace.AddCatchAllTip: A last rule taking whatever the rules above it left, so the source empties completely
Workspace.PreviewTip: Reads the source and shows where each file would go. Nothing is moved or copied.
Workspace.PreviewUnmatchedFormat: {0} match nothing and stay in the source: {1}
Workspace.RoutingEmpty: No rules yet — nothing is routed anywhere, so every file stays in the source.
Workspace.RoutingSubtitle: Matched top to bottom: each file goes to the first rule that matches it, and stays in the source if none does.
Workspace.SaveBlockedFormat: Nothing was saved yet: {0}. Finish the one still open below, or discard it.
Workspace.ShadowedByFormat: Never matches: rule {0} ("{1}") takes these files first.
Workspace.SyncDestinationHint: It doesn't have to exist yet — SyncMaid creates it on the first run.
Workspace.SyncEmpty: No destinations yet — this task has nowhere to sync to.
Workspace.SyncSubtitle: Each destination syncs the source on its own, so the same file can go to several of them.
